agent_explanation: Energy jumps 13.5kJ in one step (1065J at step30 -> 14653J at step31, limit 2684J) with no controller work. Both bodies converge on floor simultaneously: heavy body0 (m19.3) resting on floor (y=radius at step31) and light fast body1 impacts it from above while also near floor. Positional correction / impulse for overlapping body-body and body-floor constraints adds energy instead of conserving it, slingshotting body0 from vx -1.9 to +38.4 m/s. Lowering impact speed eliminates blow-up.
